code_standard: ISO 3166-2:IN subdivision codes, without the IN- prefix
note: `formed` is the first fiscal year for which RBI publishes this entity's own budget. parse_states.py checks every one of these against the data and fails if they disagree, because the workbook pads a state's pre-formation years with zeros rather than leaving them blank. Parent and successor states are kept as separate series and are never merged: adding Andhra Pradesh to Telangana double counts nothing before 2014-15 and everything after.

states.name: All States and UTs
states.note: RBI's own all-states aggregate, not a sum of the series below. It excludes the union territories before 2017-18 (except 2000-01 to 2004-05, which include them), so it is not additive with the state series in every year. Use it as published, never recomputed.

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.note: Undivided Andhra Pradesh up to 2013-14; residual Andhra Pradesh from 2014-15, after Telangana was formed on 2 June 2014. The two halves of this series are not comparable across that break.

states.name: Bihar
states.note: Undivided Bihar up to 2000-01; residual Bihar from 2001-02, after Jharkhand was formed on 15 November 2000.

states.name: Chhattisgarh
states.note: Formed from Madhya Pradesh on 1 November 2000.

states.name: Jammu and Kashmir
states.note: A state until 31 October 2019, then reorganised into the union territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. RBI keeps one series under this name; from 2019-20 it excludes Ladakh, which has no legislature and so no budget of its own and appears nowhere here.

states.name: Jharkhand
states.note: Formed from Bihar on 15 November 2000. RBI's first full year for it is 2001-02, so 2000-01 is reported under Bihar alone.

states.name: Madhya Pradesh
states.note: Undivided Madhya Pradesh up to 1999-2000; residual Madhya Pradesh from 2000-01, after Chhattisgarh was formed on 1 November 2000.

states.name: Odisha
states.note: Renamed from Orissa in 2011; RBI backdates the current name.

states.name: Telangana
states.note: Formed from Andhra Pradesh on 2 June 2014, so 2014-15 is a part year for Telangana and for residual Andhra Pradesh alike.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.note: Undivided Uttar Pradesh up to 1999-2000; residual Uttar Pradesh from 2000-01, after Uttarakhand was formed on 9 November 2000.

states.name: Uttarakhand
states.note: Formed from Uttar Pradesh on 9 November 2000, as Uttaranchal; renamed Uttarakhand in 2007.

states.name: Delhi
states.note: The National Capital Territory got a legislative assembly in 1993, which is why its budget series starts then.

states.name: Puducherry
states.note: A union territory with a legislature since 1963, but RBI's state finances series carries it only from 2005-06.
